beats.subline: Monday, October 5, 2026 close — a tech-led rally to fresh record highs as a soft September jobs report eased fears of another near-term Fed rate hike.
beats.body: The Nasdaq and Nvidia closed at fresh records as AI-linked tech names led gains, overshadowing continued bond-market weakness with the 10-year Treasury yield holding near 5.25%.

beats.headline: US monitoring mystery illness that killed Russian plague-lab worker in Siberia
beats.body: The State Department said it is tracking the case with the CDC after a 28-year-old technician at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died of 'pneumonia of unknown etiology'; nearly 200 people are under medical observation and more than 60 staff isolated, though Russian health officials say testing found no link to pathogens studied at the lab.

beats.headline: Pentagon reportedly set to embed defense officials inside Taiwan's military headquarters
beats.body: Taipei Times reports the Pentagon plans to station a Defense Department policy official and an Institute for Defense Analyses expert long-term inside Taiwan's defense ministry headquarters under an expanded, roughly $14.8 million 'Taiwan-US Defence Ministry Joint Cooperation Assessment' program running through 2028 — a shift from the US military's traditional role as outside trainers.

beats.headline: US intelligence and air support back major Saudi-led offensive against Houthis in Yemen
beats.body: Yemen's internationally recognized government launched 'Operation Yemen Dawn' this week to retake Sanaa and the Bab el-Mandeb strait from the Houthis, backed by roughly 100 Saudi aircraft; CNN reports more than 100 US military advisers in Saudi Arabia are providing targeting and geospatial intelligence while US aircraft fly midair refueling and defensive patrols for the campaign.

beats.headline: Marines to place ship-killing NMESIS missile system on Japanese island near Taiwan for first time
beats.body: The Marine Corps will deploy its NMESIS anti-ship missile system to Yonaguni, Japan's westernmost island about 110 km from Taiwan, during the US-Japan Keen Sword 27 exercise running Oct. 19-29 — the system's first deployment there, extending Marine expeditionary strike range into waters around Taiwan.

beats.headline: Meta and Microsoft scale back internal use of Anthropic's Claude over cost
beats.body: Microsoft cut its projected annual Claude spending from about $1 billion to roughly two-thirds of that and slashed individual usage caps, while Meta's internal Claude Code user base fell from about 60,000 to 30,000 employees as both companies push staff toward in-house coding tools; customer spending on Claude through Azure and Bedrock continues to grow, and Microsoft's investment in Anthropic is unaffected.

beats.headline: Bears RB Kyle Monangai day-to-day with thumb injury, expected to play at Green Bay
beats.body: Running back Kyle Monangai is listed day-to-day with a right thumb injury, but head coach Ben Johnson said imaging showed nothing serious and he expects the second-year back to be available for Sunday's game against the Packers.
